The names a round asks REDCap about, for one row that may create

upn_window.Rd

Decided on 2026-11-10 (item 4 (b') of the 0.26.0): a name REDCap still knows counts as taken, as a UPN held on Entra does, since whoever were given it would find on the instances the projects of the old login. So before a verdict that can make an account the round asks the production instances about the names it could create: the composed one, when it is free on Entra, and the first size suffixes free on Entra, in the order upn_proposal() takes them. A fixed window, so that one call per instance is enough: the proposal is the first name of the window REDCap does not know, and a window REDCap knows whole stops the row (resolve_against_directory()).

Usage

upn_window(composed, taken, size = 5L)

Arguments

composed

The UPN compose_upn() built.

taken

Normalized UPNs held by the whole tenant, as for upn_proposal().

size

How many suffixes the window holds.

Value

A character vector: the composed name first when it is free on Entra, then the suffixes, written as composed is.
